title: nan
authors: Zhang B.; Shao X.; Wang Y.; Sun G.; Yao W.
key_contribution: Presents R-LVIO, a resilient LiDAR-visual-inertial odometry system for UAV self-localization in GNSS-denied environments, validated on private and public UAV datasets.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
